t: About Us - Sterling And Noble
s: July 9, 2024 - The idea for Sterling And Noble® first emerged when our founders grew frustrated trying to find wall clocks that were both striking and well-made. Most mass-produced clocks looked flimsy or lacked character. Meanwhile, vintage clocks or higher-end contemporary designs often came with exorbitant price tags. We saw an opportunity to create beautiful, heirloom-quality pendulum clocks that were still accessible to most buyers...
